# January metadata

```{r}
jan_metadata_everythingmod <- jan_metadata %>% 
  rename(
    SAMPLE = X
  ) %>% 
    mutate_all(as.character) %>%
  select(SAMPLE, sample_type, location_name, depth_category, depth, filter, lat, long, pH, site, year, temp, prok, eukCONC) %>% 
  filter(filter != "postPCR") %>% 
  filter(filter != "NA") %>% 
  filter(location_name != "Soupy background")

jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_everythingmod %>% 
  mutate(DATASET = case_when(
    grepl("_GR_", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("Gorda", SAMPLE) ~ "GR",
    grepl("_MCR_", SAMPLE) ~ "MCR",
    grepl("Axial", SAMPLE, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial")) %>% 
  filter(!year %in% c(2013, 2014, 2015, 2019)) %>% 
  filter(!depth_category %in% c("under plume", "plume top", "30m above", "above vent", "euphotic", "oxycline")) %>% 
  filter(!sample_type %in% c("incubation", "control")) %>% 
  filter (filter != "GFF") %>% 
  filter(SAMPLE != "62_TAACAC_S14") %>% 
  mutate(
    SAMPLE = SAMPLE %>% 
      str_replace("BSW", "Background")
  )

unique(jan_metadata_everythingformatted$SAMPLE)

regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

jan_metadata_everythingformatted <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>%
  mutate(
    depth = as.numeric(depth),
    pH = as.numeric(pH),
    temp = as.numeric(temp),
    prok = as.numeric(prok),
    eukCONC = as.numeric(eukCONC)) %>% 
    mutate(
    VentField = case_when(
      grepl("Axial", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Axial_Seamount",
      grepl("Piccard", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      grepl("VonDamm", site, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "Mid-CaymanRise",
      TRUE ~ site 
    )
  )

up_janmetadata <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid) %>%
  summarise(
    pH = na_if(mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    temp = na_if(mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    prok = na_if(mean(prok, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    eukCONC = na_if(mean(eukCONC, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(merged_sampleid)

sampletype_metadata <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>% 
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid, sample_type, VentField) %>%
  summarise(
    depth = na_if(mean(depth, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    pH = na_if(mean(pH, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    temp = na_if(mean(temp, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    prok = na_if(mean(prok, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    eukCONC = na_if(mean(eukCONC, na.rm = TRUE), NaN),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  drop_na(merged_sampleid)


write_csv(sampletype_metadata, file = "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/sampletype_metadata_table.csv")

```

# Prepare MCR dataset

```{r}
df_fixed <- deepsea_18S_asv_FinalProduct %>%
rename(FeatureID = `Feature.ID`) %>%  # changed the name so the asv table and metadata table match
 rename(value = `SEQUENCE_COUNT`) %>% 
  rename(H2 = `H2.`)

new_MCR <- df_fixed %>%  # filtering out prokaryotes
  filter(DATASET == "MCR") %>% 
  filter(!Domain %in% c("Archaea", "Bacteria")) %>% 
#  filter(!Supergroup %in% c("Terrabacteria", "Archaea_X", "Bacteria_X", "CMS", "FCB")) %>% 
#  filter(!Phylum %in% c("Aquificae", "Euryarchaeota", "Proteobacteria")) %>% 
  filter(Type != "expTf") %>% 
  filter(Class != "Metazoa") %>% 
  filter(value >= 10)
# removed incubation data, i am only interested in shipboard and insitu samples
  #mutate(Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species))


mcr_ev <- new_MCR %>% 
  mutate(
    new_class = Class %>%
      str_replace("_X$", "_Unknown") %>%
      replace_na("Unknown")
  ) %>% 
   mutate(supergroup_final = case_when(
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Telonemia" ~ "Telonemia",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Stramenopiles" ~ "Stramenopiles",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Alveolata"     ~ "Alveolata",
    Supergroup == "TSAR" & Phylum == "Rhizaria"      ~ "Rhizaria",
    TRUE ~ Supergroup   # keep other supergroups as they are
  )) 

unique(mcr_ev$SAMPLE)
```

```{r}

  select(FeatureID, Taxon, Domain, Supergroup, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species, new_class, supergroup_final) %>%

  select(FeatureID, SAMPLE, value, SAMPLETYPE, SITE, COORDINATES, DEPTH, TEMP, pH, Perc, Mg, H2, H2S, CH4, LOCATION, DEPTH_CATEGORY, PRIMER, FLUID_COLLECTION, AXIAL.YEAR, EXPERIMENT, DOC..um., POC..um., TDN.um., Prok_min, Prok_mid, Prok_mid2, Prok_max, ProkConc ) %>% 
pivot_wider(names_from = SAMPLETYPE, values_from = value, values_fill = NA) %>% 
mutate(vent_assoc = case_when((vent > 0 & is.na(plume) & is.na(background))  ~ "vent_associated")) %>%
```

```{r}
regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
```

```{r}
  mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    total_sequences = as.numeric(value),
    # Create a merged sample ID independent of the original SAMPLE
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>%
  # Group by the real sample (not the original SAMPLE) + FeatureID
  group_by(merged_sampleid, SAMPLE, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

# Finding vent only asvs

```{r}
test_vent_asvs <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(SAMPLETYPE) == 1, SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>%
  ungroup()

test_vent_asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  filter(SAMPLETYPE == "vent") %>% 
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

asvs_info <- new_merged %>%
  group_by(FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(
    in_vent= any(SAMPLETYPE == "vent"),
    also_in_other_st = any(SAMPLETYPE != "vent")
  ) %>%
  filter(in_vent) %>%  # keep only ASVs present in Lake
  ungroup()

test_asvsInfor <- asvs_info %>% 
  filter(also_in_other_st == FALSE)

length(unique(test_asvsInfor$FeatureID))

ventonly_asv <- new_merged %>% left_join(test_asvsInfor) %>% 
  drop_na(in_vent)

length(unique(ventonly_asv$FeatureID))
```

```{r}
# Donut plot for plume and background
plume_and_back <- new_merged %>% 
  filter(SAMPLETYPE != "vent") %>% distinct()

donutpandb <- plume_and_back %>% 
    group_by(Phylum, new_class, VentField) %>% 
  summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
            total_sequences = sum(total_sequences))

#length(unique(donutpandb$FeatureID))

donutpandb <- donutpandb %>%
  group_by(VentField) %>%
  mutate(
    fraction = total_sequences / sum(total_sequences),
    #percent = paste0(round(100 * fraction, 1), "%"),
    ymax = cumsum(fraction),
    ymin = lag(ymax, default = 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

bpdonutplot <- ggplot(donutpandb, aes(ymax=ymax, ymin=ymin, xmax=4, xmin=3, fill= new_class)) +
     geom_rect() + scale_fill_manual(values = twibarbuniverse) + facet_wrap(~VentField, scales = "free") +
     coord_polar(theta="y") + # Try to remove that to understand how the chart is built initially
     xlim(c(2, 4)) + theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_blank()) + labs(title = "Background and Plume")
```

# Table

```{r}
asv_level <- axmcr_actual %>%
  tidyr::unite(PHYLUM_CLASS, Phylum, Class, sep = ": ", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_Annotation = ifelse(is.na(Species), "Unknown_Annotation", Species),
    is_ventassoc = status == "resident"
  ) %>%
  group_by(FeatureID, supergroup_final, PHYLUM_CLASS, Species_Annotation, is_ventassoc) %>%
  summarise(
    total_sequences = sum(total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


summary_phylum_class <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(PHYLUM_CLASS) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    resident_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID[is_ventassoc]), 
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    resident_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences[is_ventassoc]),       
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"]),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_resident_asvs = 100 * resident_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = 100 * amount_end_asvs_NAs / resident_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs = 100 * amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = 100 * amount_end_seqs_NA / resident_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs = 100 * amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences
  )


summary_super <- asv_level %>%
  group_by(supergroup_final) %>%
  summarise(
    everything_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    resident_total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID[is_ventassoc]),
    everything_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences),
    resident_total_sequences = sum(total_sequences[is_ventassoc]),
    amount_all_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"),
    amount_end_asvs_NAs = sum(Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc),
    amount_all_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation"]),
    amount_end_seqs_NA = sum(total_sequences[Species_Annotation == "Unknown_Annotation" & is_ventassoc]),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    percent_resident_asvs = 100 * resident_total_asvs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_end_asvs = 100 * amount_end_asvs_NAs / resident_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_all_asvs = 100 * amount_all_asvs_NAs / everything_total_asvs,
    percent_NA_end_seqs = 100 * amount_end_seqs_NA / resident_total_sequences,
    percent_NA_all_seqs = 100 * amount_all_seqs_NA / everything_total_sequences,
    percent_resident_seqs = 100 * resident_total_sequences / everything_total_sequences
  )

write_csv(summary_phylum_class, file = "~/Documents/GitHub/AXMCR/Summary_PhylumClass_Table.csv")
```

```{r}
deeply <- ventonly_asv %>% 
  filter(supergroup_final %in% c("Excavata", "Amoebozoa", "Telonemia", "CRuMs", "Obazoa", "Provora"))
  #filter(Phylum %in% c("Apusomonada"))



deeply_pa <- deeply %>% 
  filter(Phylum != "Opisthokonta") %>% 
  group_by(LOCATION, Phylum, VentField, SITE) %>% 
  summarise(Total_ASVs = n(), .groups = "drop")
  

#pa_2 <- deeply_pa %>% 
  #group_by(supergroup_final, Phylum, LOCATION, VentField) %>% 
  #summarise(total_asvs = n_distinct(FeatureID),
    #        total_there = sum(pa),
        #    .groups = "drop")
deeplypa_plot <- ggplot(deeply_pa, aes(x = LOCATION, y = Total_ASVs , fill = Phylum)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7) +
  #geom_col(position = position_dodge2(preserve = "single")) +
  #facet_wrap(~ VentField + SITE, scales = "free_x") +
  #facet_wrap(~ VentField + SITE, scales = "free_x",labeller = labeller(
  facet_wrap(~ VentField, scales = "free_x",labeller = labeller(
```

```{r}
plot_diversity <- function(df, index_name) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = sample_type, y = !!sym(index_name), color = location_name)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.25, size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(~VentField) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste(index_name, "by Sample Type"),
      x = "Sample Type",
      y = index_name,
      color = "Location"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = div_colors) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
}
```

# Heatstrip
```{r}
heatstrip_info <- sampletype_metadata %>% 
  mutate(log_prok = log10(prok)) %>% 
  mutate(log_euk = log10(eukCONC)) %>% 
select(merged_sampleid, pH, temp, prok, eukCONC, VentField, log_prok, log_euk, depth) %>% 
  mutate(pH_range = case_when(
    pH > 0 & pH <= 1.9 ~ "1",
    pH > 2.0 & pH <= 2.9 ~ "2",
    pH > 3.0 & pH <= 3.9 ~ "3",
    pH > 4.0 & pH <= 4.9 ~ "4",
    pH > 5.0 & pH <= 5.9 ~ "5",
    pH > 6.0 & pH <= 6.9 ~ "6",
    pH > 7.0 & pH <= 7.9 ~ "7",
    pH > 8.0 & pH <= 8.9 ~ "8",
    pH > 9.0 & pH <= 9.9 ~ "9",
    pH > 10.0 & pH <= 10.9 ~ "10",
    pH > 11.0 & pH <= 11.9 ~ "11",
    pH > 12.0 & pH <= 12.9 ~ "12",
    pH > 13.0 & pH <= 13.4 ~ "13",
    pH = 13.5 & pH <= 14.0 ~ "14")) %>% 
  mutate(temp_range = case_when(
    temp > 0 & temp <= 10 ~ "0-10",
    temp > 11 & temp <= 20 ~ "11-20",
    temp > 21 & temp <= 30 ~ "21-30",
    temp > 31 & temp <= 40 ~ "31-40",
    temp > 41 & temp <= 50 ~ "41-50",
    temp > 51 & temp <= 60 ~ "51-60",
    temp > 61 & temp <= 70 ~ "61-70",
    temp > 71 & temp <= 80 ~ "71-80",
    temp > 81 & temp <= 90 ~ "81-90",
    temp > 91 & temp <= 100 ~ "91-100",
    temp > 101 & temp <= 110 ~ "101-110",
    temp > 111 & temp <= 120 ~ "111-120",
    temp > 121 & temp <= 130 ~ "121-130",
    temp = 131 & temp <= 140 ~ "131 -140")) %>% 
  mutate(log_prok_range = case_when(
    log_prok >= 4   & log_prok <= 4.5 ~ "4.0-4.5",
    log_prok > 4.5  & log_prok <= 5.0 ~ "4.5-5.0",
    log_prok > 5.0  & log_prok <= 5.5 ~ "5.0-5.5"
  )) %>% 
  mutate(EukConc_range = case_when(
    eukCONC >= 0   & eukCONC <= 50   ~ "0 - 50",
    eukCONC > 50   & eukCONC <= 100  ~ "51 - 100",
    eukCONC > 100  & eukCONC <= 150  ~ "101 - 150",
    eukCONC > 150  & eukCONC <= 200  ~ "151 - 200",
    eukCONC > 200  & eukCONC <= 250  ~ "201 - 250",
    eukCONC > 250  & eukCONC <= 300  ~ "251 - 300",
    eukCONC > 300  & eukCONC <= 350  ~ "301 - 350",
    eukCONC > 350  & eukCONC <= 400  ~ "351 - 400",
    eukCONC > 400  & eukCONC <= 450  ~ "401 - 450",
    eukCONC > 450  & eukCONC <= 500  ~ "451 - 500",
    eukCONC > 500  & eukCONC <= 550  ~ "501 - 550",
    eukCONC > 550  & eukCONC <= 600  ~ "551 - 600",
)) %>% 
  mutate(log_euk_range = case_when(
    log_euk > 1.0 & log_euk <= 1.5 ~ "1.0-1.5",
    log_euk > 1.5 & log_euk <= 2.0 ~ "1.5-2.0",
    log_euk > 2.0 & log_euk <= 2.5 ~ "2.0-2.5",
    log_euk > 2.5 & log_euk <= 3.0 ~ "2.5-3.0"
)) %>% 
  
mutate(depth_range = case_when(
  depth > 1000 & depth <= 1999 ~ "1000-1999",
  depth > 2000 & depth <= 2999 ~ "2000-2999",
  depth > 3000 & depth <= 3999 ~ "3000-3999",
  depth > 4000 & depth <= 4999 ~ "4000-4999",
))
```

```{r}
heatstrip_info <- sampletype_metadata %>%
  transmute(
    merged_sampleid,
    pH,
    temp,
    prok,
    eukCONC,
    depth,
    VentField,

    log_prok = log10(prok),
    log_euk  = log10(eukCONC),

    # pH bins
    pH_range = cut(
      pH,
      breaks = seq(0, 14, by = 1),
      labels = as.character(1:14),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # temperature bins
    temp_range = cut(
      temp,
      breaks = seq(0, 140, by = 10),
      labels = paste(
        seq(0, 130, by = 10),
        seq(10, 140, by = 10),
        sep = "-"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # log prok bins
    log_prok_range = cut(
      log10(prok),
      breaks = seq(4, 5.5, by = 0.5),
      labels = c("4.0-4.5", "4.5-5.0", "5.0-5.5"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # euk concentration bins
    EukConc_range = cut(
      eukCONC,
      breaks = seq(0, 600, by = 50),
      labels = paste(
        seq(0, 550, by = 50),
        seq(50, 600, by = 50),
        sep = "-"
      ),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),

    # log euk bins
    log_euk_range = cut(
      log10(eukCONC),
      breaks = seq(1.0, 3.0, by = 0.5),
      labels = c("1.0-1.5", "1.5-2.0", "2.0-2.5", "2.5-3.0"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    ),
    
    # depth bins
    depth_range = cut(
      depth,
      breaks = seq(1000, 5000, by = 1000),
      labels = c("1000 - 1999", "2000 - 2999", "3000 - 3999", "4000-4999"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}
matrix_heatstrip <- new_merged %>% 
  select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = merged_sampleid, values_from = total_sequences, values_fn = mean, values_fill = 0) %>% 
  column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>% as.matrix()

pca_clr <- prcomp(data.frame(compositions::clr(t(matrix_heatstrip))))

variance_clr <- (pca_clr$sdev^2)/sum(pca_clr$sdev^2)

barplot(variance_clr, main = "Log-Ratio PCA Screeplot", xlab = "PC Axis", ylab = "% Variance", 
        cex.names = 1.5, cex.axis = 1.5, cex.lab = 1.5, cex.main = 1.5)
```

```{r}
PCA_PLOT <- data.frame(pca_clr$x, SAMPLE = rownames(pca_clr$x)) %>% 
  select(PC1, PC2, SAMPLE) %>% 
  left_join(heatstrip_info, by = "merged_sampleid") %>% 
  # Factoring
  mutate(
    pH_order = factor(pH_range, levels = unique(pH_range))
  )%>% 
  #mutate(FEATURE = str_replace_na(FEATURE, replacement = "other")) %>% 
  ## Generate PCA plot
  ggplot(aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, 
             fill = pH_order)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "#525252") +
  geom_jitter(stroke = 0.6, size = 2.5, width = 0.8) +
  ylab(paste0('PC2 ',round(variance_clr[2]*100,2),'%')) +
  xlab(paste0('PC1 ',round(variance_clr[1]*100,2),'%')) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(24, 23, 21, 22)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ph_colors) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(color="black", size=12),
        legend.title = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey70", linetype = "dashed"),
        axis.title = element_text(color="black", size= 12),
        legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 8, face = "bold"),
        plot.margin = margin(2, 1, 2, 1, "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    color = "black", 
    shape = 22, 
    size = 5)),
    shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(
    color = "black", 
    size = 5)))

print(PCA_PLOT)
```

```{r}
#install.packages("ggdendro")
library(ggdendro)

# distance between samples
heatstrip_dist <- dist(t(matrix_heatstrip), method = "euclidean")

# cluster
heatstrip_cluster <- hclust(heatstrip_dist, method = "complete")

# set as dendrogram object
dend <- as.dendrogram(heatstrip_cluster)


labels_pH <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_temp <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_counts <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_euks <- as.character(labels(dend))
labels_depth <- as.character(labels(dend))

sample_order <- c("AXIAL_Background", "AXIAL_ASHES", "AXIAL_Anemone", "AXIAL_BagCity", "AXIAL_Diva", "AXIAL_Gollum", "AXIAL_IntlDist", "AXIAL_Mkr113", "AXIAL_Mkr33", "AXIAL_Vixen", "MCR_Background", "MCR_ArrowLoop",  "MCR_LotsOShrimp", "MCR_MustardStand", "MCR_OldManTree", "MCR_Plume", "MCR_Rav2", "MCR_ShrimpHole", "MCR_Shrimpocalypse", "MCR_WhiteCastle")  

label_order = factor(sample_order, levels = sample_order)
#label_order = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = merged_sampleid)

anno_pH <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_pH) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>%
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%
  mutate(pH_range = factor(pH_range, levels = pH_levels))

anno_temp <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_temp) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%   # alphabetical
  mutate(temp_range = factor(temp_range, levels = temp_levels))

anno_counts <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(pH, pH_range, merged_sampleid, temp, temp_range, VentField, log_prok_range, log_prok) %>%
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_counts) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%  # alphabetical order
  mutate(log_prok_range = factor(log_prok_range, levels = proklog_levels))


anno_euks <- heatstrip_info %>% 
select(eukCONC, EukConc_range, merged_sampleid, VentField, log_euk, log_euk_range) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_euks) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%  # alphabetical order
 #mutate(EukConc_range = factor(EukConc_range, levels = euk_levels))
  mutate(log_euk_range = factor(log_euk_range, levels = euklog_levels))

anno_depth <- heatstrip_info %>% 
  select(depth, depth_range, merged_sampleid, depth, depth_range, VentField) %>% 
  filter(merged_sampleid %in% labels_depth) %>% 
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(merged_sampleid = factor(merged_sampleid, levels = sample_order)) %>% 
  arrange(merged_sampleid) %>%   # alphabetical
  mutate(temp_range = factor(depth_range, levels = depth_levels))
```

```{r}
regions   <- c("MCR","AXIAL")
locations <- c("Plume","ArrowLoop","WhiteCastle","MustardStand","ShrimpHole",
               "Shrimpocalypse","Rav2","LotsOShrimp","Anemone","BagCity","Gollum",
               "Diva","Mkr33","Mkr113","Background","Vixen","ASHES","IntlDist","OldManTree")

metadata_quick <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>%
    mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid)) %>%
  distinct(merged_sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type    = ifelse(is.na(sample_type), "Unknown", sample_type),
    location_name  = ifelse(is.na(location_name), "Unknown", location_name),
    VentField      = ifelse(is.na(VentField), "Unknown", VentField)
  )

otu_wide <- new_merged %>%
  select(merged_sampleid, FeatureID, total_sequences) %>%
  group_by(merged_sampleid, FeatureID) %>%
  summarise(total_sequences = sum(total_sequences), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = FeatureID,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0
  )

sample_ids <- otu_wide$merged_sampleid
comm_matrix <- otu_wide %>% select(-merged_sampleid) %>% as.matrix()
rownames(comm_matrix) <- sample_ids

shannon <- diversity(comm_matrix, index = "shannon")
simpson <- 1 - diversity(comm_matrix, index = "simpson")
chao1 <- estimateR(comm_matrix)["S.chao1", ]

div_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = sample_ids,
  Shannon = shannon,
  Simpson = simpson,
  Chao1 = chao1
)

div_df <- data.frame(
  Sample = names(shannon_everything),
  Shannon = shannon_everything,
  Simpson = simpson_everything
)


div_long <- pivot_longer(div_df,
                        cols = c(Shannon, Simpson),
                        names_to = "Index",
                        values_to = "Value")

ggplot(div_long, aes(x = Index, y = Value, color = Index, fill = )) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal()

div_table <- div_table %>%
  left_join(metadata_quick, by = c("Sample" = "merged_sampleid"))


loc_colors <- viridis::viridis(n = length(unique(div_table$location_name)), option = "plasma")
names(loc_colors) <- unique(div_table$location_name)


plot_diversity <- function(df, index_name) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = sample_type, y = !!sym(index_name), color = location_name)) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.25, size = 4, alpha = 0.8) +
    facet_grid(~VentField) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    labs(
      title = paste(index_name, "by Sample Type"),
      x = "Sample Type",
      y = index_name,
      color = "Location"
    ) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = div_colors) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12)
    )
}


shannon_plot <- plot_diversity(div_table, "Shannon")
simpson_plot <- plot_diversity(div_table, "Simpson")
chao1_plot   <- plot_diversity(div_table, "Chao1")

# Display them
shannon_plot
simpson_plot
chao1_plot
```

# Phyloseq for Vent-Exclusive ASVs
## Metadata for phyloseq

```{r}
metadata_quick <- jan_metadata_everythingformatted %>%
    mutate(
    region = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(regions, collapse = "|")),
    location = str_extract(SAMPLE, paste(locations, collapse = "|")),
    merged_sampleid = str_c(region, "_", location)
  ) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(merged_sampleid)) %>%
  distinct(merged_sampleid, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_type    = ifelse(is.na(sample_type), "Unknown", sample_type),
    location_name  = ifelse(is.na(location_name), "Unknown", location_name),
    VentField      = ifelse(is.na(VentField), "Unknown", VentField)
  )
```

## Format for Phyloseq

```{r}
ventonly_taxon <- ventonly_asv %>% 
  select(FeatureID, Domain, Supergroup, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species) %>% distinct() %>% column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>% 
  as.matrix()

vent_asvs <- ventonly_asv %>% 
  dplyr::select(FeatureID, merged_sampleid, total_sequences) %>% distinct() 

vent_asvs_matrix <- vent_asvs %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = merged_sampleid,
    values_from = total_sequences,
    values_fill = 0,
    values_fn = mean
  ) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "FeatureID") %>%
  as.matrix()

vent_taxa = tax_table(ventonly_taxon)
vent_otu_asvs = otu_table(vent_asvs_matrix, taxa_are_rows = TRUE)

head(vent_asvs_matrix)

vent_physeq_object <- merge_phyloseq(vent_otu_asvs, vent_taxa, metadata_quick)
```
